mapper.insert: /* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertSchdlAtrbFromDaily */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SCHDL_ATRB ( SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID, DOM_INTL_SE_CD, ARR_DEP_SE_CD, TMNL_ID, ALN_CD, FLTNM, DEP_ARR_YMD, DEP_ARR_HM, PREDC_HM, ACTL_HM, ARR_DEP_ARPT_CD, ACST_NO, GATE_NO, ARCFT_STGCP, BDPSG_CNT, TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, CRSL_NO, ARCFT_SUBTYPE_CD, IRR_FLT_YN, TDFLT_YN, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, X.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, X.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, X.TMNL_ID, X.ALN_CD, X.FLTNM, X.DEP_ARR_YMD, X.DEP_ARR_HM, X.PREDC_HM, X.ACTL_HM, X.ARPT_CD, X.ACST_NO, X.GATE_NO, X.ARCFT_STGCP, ROUND(NVL(X.BDPSG_CNT, 0) * (100 + X.AJMT_RT) / 100), X.TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, X.CRSL_NO, X.ARCFT_SUBTYPE_CD, X.IRR_FLT_YN, X.TDFLT_YN, #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ( SELECT A.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, A.TMNL_ID, A.ALN_CD, A.FLTNM, A.GD_SE_YMD AS DEP_ARR_YMD, A.SCHDL_HM AS DEP_ARR_HM, A.PREDC_HM, A.ACTL_HM, A.ARPT_CD, A.ACST_NO, A.GATE_NO, A.ARCFT_STGCP, A.RSVT_BDPSG_CNT AS BDPSG_CNT, A.RSVT_TRNS_BDPSG_CNT AS TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, A.CRSL_NO, A.ARCFT_SUBTYPE_CD, A.GD_IRR_YN AS IRR_FLT_YN, A.TDFLT_YN, NVL(( SELECT CASE WHEN F.AJMT_TYPE_CD = 'HOURLY' THEN NVL(( SELECT T.AJMT_RT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_FLT_PSG_TMZN_AJMT T WHERE T.SMLT_ID = F.SMLT_ID AND T.TMNL_ID = F.TMNL_ID AND NVL(A.PREDC_HM, A.SCHDL_HM) >= T.BGNG_HM AND NVL(A.PREDC_HM, A.SCHDL_HM) < NVL(T.END_HM, '2400') AND ROWNUM = 1 ), 0) ELSE NVL(F.AJMT_RT, 0) END FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_FLT_PSG_AJMT F WHERE F.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND F.TMNL_ID = DECODE(A.TMNL_ID, 'P01', 'P01', 'P02', 'P01', 'P03', 'P03') ), 0) AS AJMT_RT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, A.FLTNM, A.GD_SE_YMD, A.SCHDL_HM ORDER BY A.RSVT_BDPSG_CNT DESC NULLS LAST ) AS RN FROM GOOWN.TN_GO_GD_DATA A WHERE A.GD_SE_YMD = #{excnYmd} AND A.CSHR_STTS_CD != 'SL' AND A.DLY_RSN_CD NOT IN ('2', '3') AND A.TMNL_ID IN ('P', 'P01', 'P02', 'P03') AND A.ARCFT_USE_SE_CD = '0' AND A.GD_FLT_PRPS_CD IN ('00', '05') AND A.PSG_CGO_SE_CD = 'Y' AND A.FRY_YN = 'N' AND A.LCRFT_YN = 'N' AND A.SCHDL_HM IS NOT NULL ) X WHERE X.RN = 1

/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertSchdlAtrbFromSrc */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SCHDL_ATRB ( SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID, DOM_INTL_SE_CD, ARR_DEP_SE_CD, TMNL_ID, ALN_CD, ALN_CTGRY, FLTNM, DALY_FLTSH_ID, DEP_ARR_YMD, DEP_ARR_HM, PREDC_HM, ACTL_HM, ARR_DEP_ARPT_CD, ACST_NO, GATE_NO, GATE_TYPE, ARCFT_STGCP, BDPSG_CNT, TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, CRSL_NO, ARCFT_SUBTYPE_CD, CKNCT_RANGE_CN, SLF_CHKN_PSBLTY_YN, IRR_FLT_YN, TDFLT_YN, BUS_NEED_YN, WAYO_ID, FRST_BAG_INPUT_DT, LAST_BAG_INPUT_DT, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, A.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, A.ARR_DEP_SE_CD, A.TMNL_ID, A.ALN_CD, A.ALN_CTGRY, A.FLTNM, A.DALY_FLTSH_ID, A.DEP_ARR_YMD, A.DEP_ARR_HM, A.PREDC_HM, A.ACTL_HM, A.ARR_DEP_ARPT_CD, A.ACST_NO, A.GATE_NO, A.GATE_TYPE, A.ARCFT_STGCP, ROUND(NVL(A.BDPSG_CNT, 0) * (100 + NVL(( SELECT CASE WHEN F.AJMT_TYPE_CD = 'HOURLY' THEN NVL(( SELECT T.AJMT_RT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_FLT_PSG_TMZN_AJMT T WHERE T.SMLT_ID = F.SMLT_ID AND T.TMNL_ID = F.TMNL_ID AND NVL(A.PREDC_HM, A.DEP_ARR_HM) >= T.BGNG_HM AND NVL(A.PREDC_HM, A.DEP_ARR_HM) < NVL(T.END_HM, '2400') AND ROWNUM = 1 ), 0) ELSE NVL(F.AJMT_RT, 0) END FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_FLT_PSG_AJMT F WHERE F.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND F.TMNL_ID = DECODE(A.TMNL_ID, 'P01', 'P01', 'P02', 'P01', 'P03', 'P03') ), 0) ) / 100), A.TRNS_BDPSG_CNT, A.CRSL_NO, A.ARCFT_SUBTYPE_CD, A.CKNCT_RANGE_CN, A.SLF_CHKN_PSBLTY_YN, A.IRR_FLT_YN, A.TDFLT_YN, A.BUS_NEED_YN, A.WAYO_ID, A.FRST_BAG_INPUT_DT, A.LAST_BAG_INPUT_DT, #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SCHDL_ATRB A WHERE A.SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID = REPLACE(#{srcFltSchdlRsrcId}, 'FS', '')

/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertCknctAtrb */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_CKNCT_ATRB ( SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID, BLCK_ID, TMNL_ID, CKNCT_ID, ALN_CD, DOM_INTL_SE_CD, CRTR_YMD, CHKN_OPEN_PRNMNT_DT, CHKN_CLOSE_PRNMNT_DT, CHKN_TYPE_CD, CHKN_TYPE_DTL_INFO, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, CASE WHEN B.TMNL_ID = 'P03' THEN 'P03CKIN' WHEN NVL(C.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, 'I') = 'I' THEN 'P01CKINInt' ELSE 'P01CKINDom' END, B.TMNL_ID, C.CKNCT_ID, B.ALN_CD, NVL(C.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, 'I'), #{excnYmd}, #{excnYmd} || LPAD(H.OPER_BGNG_HOUR, 2, '0') || '00', #{excnYmd} || LPAD(DECODE(H.OPER_END_HOUR, 24, 23, H.OPER_END_HOUR), 2, '0') || DECODE(H.OPER_END_HOUR, 24, '59', '00'), 'M', B.ALN_CD, #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_BOOTH B INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_OPER_HR H ON H.SMLT_ID = B.SMLT_ID AND H.TMNL_ID = B.TMNL_ID AND H.CHKN_ISL_CD = B.CHKN_ISL_CD INNER JOIN ( SELECT K.TMNL_ID, SUBSTR(K.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) AS CHKN_ISL_CD, K.CKNCT_ID, K.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY K.TMNL_ID, SUBSTR(K.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) ORDER BY K.CKNCT_ID) AS BOOTH_NO FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_CKNCT K WHERE K.USE_YN = 'Y' AND K.CKNCT_USE_CRG_APLCN_TYPE_CD IN ('A', 'B') ) C ON C.TMNL_ID = B.TMNL_ID AND C.CHKN_ISL_CD = B.CHKN_ISL_CD AND C.BOOTH_NO = B.BOOTH_NO WHERE B.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND B.ALN_CD IS NOT NULL

/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertSbdAtrb */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SBD_ATRB ( SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID, BLCK_ID, TMNL_ID, CKNCT_ID, ALN_CD, DOM_INTL_SE_CD, CRTR_YMD, OPER_BGNG_DT, OPER_END_DT, CHKN_TYPE_CD, CHKN_TYPE_DTL_INFO, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, CASE WHEN I.TMNL_ID = 'P03' THEN 'P03SBD' ELSE 'P01SBD' END, I.TMNL_ID, C.CKNCT_ID, A.ALN_CD, NVL(C.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, 'I'), #{excnYmd}, #{excnYmd} || LPAD(H.OPER_BGNG_HOUR, 2, '0') || '00', #{excnYmd} || LPAD(DECODE(H.OPER_END_HOUR, 24, 23, H.OPER_END_HOUR), 2, '0') || DECODE(H.OPER_END_HOUR, 24, '59', '00'), 'C', SUBSTR(A.ALN_CD_LIST, 1, 200), #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_ISL I INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_OPER_HR H ON H.SMLT_ID = I.SMLT_ID AND H.TMNL_ID = I.TMNL_ID AND H.CHKN_ISL_CD = I.CHKN_ISL_CD INNER JOIN ( SELECT K.TMNL_ID, SUBSTR(K.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) AS CHKN_ISL_CD, K.CKNCT_ID, K.DOM_INTL_SE_CD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY K.TMNL_ID, SUBSTR(K.CKNCT_ID, 1, 1) ORDER BY K.CKNCT_ID) AS DEVICE_NO FROM CAOWN.TN_CA_CKNCT K WHERE K.USE_YN = 'Y' AND K.CKNCT_USE_CRG_APLCN_TYPE_CD = 'H' ) C ON C.TMNL_ID = I.TMNL_ID AND C.CHKN_ISL_CD = I.CHKN_ISL_CD AND C.DEVICE_NO <= NVL(I.SBD_CNT, 0) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT SMLT_ID, TMNL_ID, CHKN_ISL_CD, MIN(ALN_CD) AS ALN_CD, LISTAGG(ALN_CD, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ALN_CD) AS ALN_CD_LIST FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT SMLT_ID, TMNL_ID, CHKN_ISL_CD, ALN_CD FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_BOOTH WHERE ALN_CD IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY SMLT_ID, TMNL_ID, CHKN_ISL_CD ) A ON A.SMLT_ID = I.SMLT_ID AND A.TMNL_ID = I.TMNL_ID AND A.CHKN_ISL_CD = I.CHKN_ISL_CD WHERE I.SMLT_ID = #{smltId}

/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertSbdAtrbKiosk */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_SBD_ATRB ( SCHDL_ATRB_GROUP_ID, BLCK_ID, TMNL_ID, CKNCT_ID, ALN_CD, DOM_INTL_SE_CD, CRTR_YMD, OPER_BGNG_DT, OPER_END_DT, CHKN_TYPE_CD, CHKN_TYPE_DTL_INFO, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, CASE WHEN I.TMNL_ID = 'P03' THEN 'P03Self' ELSE 'P01Self' END, I.TMNL_ID, C.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID, C.ALN_CD, 'I', #{excnYmd}, #{excnYmd} || LPAD(H.OPER_BGNG_HOUR, 2, '0') || '00', #{excnYmd} || LPAD(DECODE(H.OPER_END_HOUR, 24, 23, H.OPER_END_HOUR), 2, '0') || DECODE(H.OPER_END_HOUR, 24, '59', '00'), 'C', SUBSTR(C.ALN_CD_LIST, 1, 200), #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_ISL I INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_CHKN_OPER_HR H ON H.SMLT_ID = I.SMLT_ID AND H.TMNL_ID = I.TMNL_ID AND H.CHKN_ISL_CD = I.CHKN_ISL_CD INNER JOIN ( SELECT P.TMNL_ID, SUBSTR(P.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID, 1, 1) AS CHKN_ISL_CD, P.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID, MIN(P.ALN_CD) AS ALN_CD, LISTAGG(P.ALN_CD, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY P.ALN_CD) AS ALN_CD_LIST, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P.TMNL_ID, SUBSTR(P.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID, 1, 1) ORDER BY P.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID) AS DEVICE_NO FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SLF_CHKN_OPER_PLCY P WHERE #{excnYmd} BETWEEN P.PLCY_BGNG_YMD AND P.PLCY_END_YMD GROUP BY P.TMNL_ID, SUBSTR(P.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID, 1, 1), P.SLF_CHKN_ISTR_ID ) C ON C.TMNL_ID = I.TMNL_ID AND C.CHKN_ISL_CD = I.CHKN_ISL_CD AND C.DEVICE_NO <= NVL(I.KOS_CNT, 0) WHERE I.SMLT_ID = #{smltId}

/* CastUserSnapshotMapper.insertDptgtAtrb */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FCLTY_OPNG_DPTGT_ATRB ( DPTGT_ATRB_ID, FCLTY_OPNG_SN, TMNL_ID, FCLT_SE_CD, GATE_NO, FCLTY_CNT, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) SELECT #{rsrcNo}, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY D.TMNL_ID, D.DPTGT_NO), D.TMNL_ID, 'D', D.DPTGT_NO, NVL(D.GNRL_SRCH_CNTOM, 0) + NVL(D.SMART_PASS_SRCH_CNTOM, 0), #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_USER_DPTGT D WHERE D.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND D.OPER_YN = 'Y'
